name: Emin Yusuf AYDIN
about: I am a postdoctoral researcher at Hacettepe University. I completed my PhD in Bioengineering at Hacettepe University, where I investigated active sensing, multisensory integration, and sensorimotor control in weakly electric fish using closed-loop behavioral experiments, computational modeling, and system identification.

My current research interests span systems and behavioral neuroscience, electrophysiology, neural sensing, bioinspired robotics, control systems, and the translation of biological sensing principles into engineering applications.

I am currently working as a postdoctoral researcher on a TÜSEB-supported bioelectric sensing catheter project while continuing research on active sensing and preparing for international postdoctoral research collaborations.
